read.title: Our Apology for Your Recent Order
read.text:
Dear Ms. Carter,

Thank you for contacting us about your recent order. We are very sorry that the coffee machine you received was faulty, and we apologize for the inconvenience this has caused.

We looked into the issue and found that the machine was damaged during shipping. A replacement was sent out this morning by express delivery, and it should arrive within two business days. You do not need to return the faulty machine.

To make up for the trouble, we have also added a discount voucher to your account. You can use it on your next purchase.

Resolving your complaint is our top priority. If the problem is not fully solved, please reply to this email and I will personally assist you.

Sincerely,
Daniel Reed
Customer Care Team

write.task: 납품한 사무용 의자 중 일부가 파손된 채 도착해서 거래처 담당자가 불만 메일을 보냈어요. 사과하고, 원인을 확인하겠다는 말과 해결 방법(새 제품 발송)을 알리는 답장을 써 보세요.
write.en: Reply to a client's complaint about damaged office chairs: apologize, say you will look into the cause, and explain how you will resolve it.
write.model:
Dear Ms. Evans,

I'm sorry to hear that some of the chairs arrived damaged. We apologize for the inconvenience. I will look into the cause with our shipping team today. To resolve this quickly, we will send new chairs tomorrow morning at no extra cost. Please let me know if there is anything else we can do.

Best regards,
Minsu
